This unit has two MIDI interfaces, so channels 17-32 are the second one. They are real channels whether
or not anything is plugged into it.
Write gate locked: editing a cell — ⏎, + and -, space, or s — writes the whole setup dump. p2ked reads
the live dump, changes this one field and sends the dump back (spec p. 29), so every other byte is the
one the unit just sent. The field is read back to verify it, and z — here or in the browser — puts the
previous value back. A burst of nudges on one cell is not refused and not lost: the row moves as each
one is pressed, the writes still go out one at a time and are still read back, and z steps back through
the values that were actually sent.
The ROM column reads the SIMM ID as that ROM's Bank Select MSB. No E-MU document to hand says they are
the same number; it was confirmed against hardware for three ROMs on 2026-09-12, which is not all
What this report cannot see, because the unit does not report it: the cable, an unplugged submix jack,
the monitor, and anything set on the preset rather than the channel.
